coaching.coaching: Add a regression test covering position-independence of global flag extraction.
coaching.subject: position-independence of global flag extraction

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Verify global-flag extraction cannot swallow a self-parsing verb's option value (e.g. `-d -o`) and document/handle the collision.
evidence: `parse_output` matches any bare `-o`/`--output` token positionally and grabs the next token as its value (src/rebar/_engine_support/output.py:112-118)
`extract_global_flags` calls `parse_output(kept, ...)` over the whole pre-`--` head (src/rebar/_commands/_confirm.py:84), running ahead of the composers' own `-d`/`--assignee` parsers
The `--` escape mitigates but requires the caller to know to use it; the `-q`/`--quiet` stripping has the same collision for a flag value equal to `-q`.
dropped.finding: `extract_global_flags` runs `parse_output` over the entire pre-`--` argv segment at the router, BEFORE each self-parsing verb sees its own flags, so a verb-option value that is literally `-o`/`--output`/`-q` is consumed as a global flag rather than treated as the option's value (e.g. `rebar create task t -d -o` makes `-o` a value-less `--output` and raises exit-2 'requires a value' before `-d` is bound).

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Update the transition.py module docstring to reflect the new `transitioned`/`claimed` confirmation output (drop the `UNBLOCKED:`/`CLAIMED:` references).
evidence: src/rebar/_commands/transition.py:10-12: "``{ticket_id,from,to,newly_unblocked}`` json / ``UNBLOCKED:`` text output, and claim's error-envelope ... + ``CLAIMED:`` output."
The change replaced `UNBLOCKED:` with `transitioned ...; unblocked: ...` and `CLAIMED:` with `claimed ...` (src/rebar/_commands/transition.py:585, src/rebar/_commands/claim.py:353).
dropped.finding: The `transition` module docstring still describes the removed `UNBLOCKED:` text output and `CLAIMED:` output, which this change renamed to the new confirmation contract, leaving the docstring stale/misleading.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test placing --quiet/-q (and -o json) BEFORE and BETWEEN a verb's positionals (e.g. `tag -q <id> <tag>`) to pin the documented position-independence of global-flag extraction.
evidence: src/rebar/_commands/_confirm.py:79 loop `for tok in head:` makes extraction position-independent across the pre-`--` segment
docs/user-guide.md diff: 'position-independent within the verb's arguments'; src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py comment on _dispatch_confirmable states the same

All flag placements in the test file are trailing: line 108 `_cli("comment", tid, "quiet body", "--quiet")`, line 129 `_cli("tag", tid, "qt", "--quiet", "--output", "json")`, line 413 `_cli("create", "task", "quiet create", "-q")`; search for `-q` at test file lines 38/316/413 shows no interspersed/leading placement
ABSENCE: no test asserts e.g. `rebar tag -q <id> <tag>` (flag before positionals) or `rebar comment <id> --quiet <body>` yields the same suppression
dropped.finding: The documented 'position-independent within the verb's arguments' behavior of the global --quiet/-q and --output/-o extraction (extract_global_flags iterating the entire pre-`--` head) is never exercised with a flag placed before or between positionals — every test in test_mutation_confirmations.py places these flags trailing or after `--`, so a regression to trailing-only extraction would pass the whole suite.
scenarios: A user or script places -q/--output ahead of or between the verb's positionals; a refactor to check only the trailing token would silently break this while the suite stays green
dropped.suggested_fix: Add a case like `_cli("tag", "-q", tid, "z", repo=repo)` asserting empty stdout + exit 0, and `_cli("comment", tid, "-o", "json", "body", repo=repo)` asserting the JSON envelope, so extraction cannot regress to trailing-only.
